source_title: Kane beat Mbappe to Ballon d'Or by just 28 points
source_excerpt:
'My heart was beating so fast' - Kane wins Ballon D'or
Harry Kane beat second-placed Kylian Mbappe to the men's Ballon d'Or by just 28 points - one of the smallest winning margins in the award's history.
Organisers released voting numbers on Saturday, showing that England captain Kane was awarded 1,055 points, compared with 1,027 for Real Madrid's France forward Mbappe.
Bayern Munich striker Kane became the first Englishman to win the award since Michael Owen in 2001, while France talisman Mbappe also claimed his best finish, ending up well clear of Spain forward Lamine Yamal, who was third with 881 points.
It was the smallest winning margin since Argentina great Lionel Messi beat Liverpool defender Virgil van Dijk by seven points in 2019, while the men's Ballon d'Or has twice been decided by a single point.
That happened when England World Cup winner Bobby Charlton, who was later knighted, beat Portugal star Eusebio by the smallest possible margin in 1966, and Germany defender Matthias Sammer repeated the tight one-point victory when he edged out Brazil striker Ronaldo in 1996.
Mbappe may take heart from Ronaldo's Ballon d'Or experience as the legendary frontman, who presented Kane with his award in London on Monday, went on to win in 1997 and again in 2002.
Harry Kane is the fifth English player to win the Ballon d'Or, after Stanley Matthews (1956), Bobby Charlton (1966), Kevin Keegan (1978 & 1979) and Michael Owen (2001)
Kane clinched the prize after scoring 73 goals in 65 matches last season, helping Bayern Munich to a league and cup double and leading England to a third-place finish at the World Cup.
The award is decided by votes from 100 journalists, using a weighted points system.
Speaking about Mbappe missing out on the award, Real Madrid head coach Jose Mourinho said the 27-year-old was dealing brilliantly with the disappointment.
"Kylian is very intelligent and mature. He has very high self-esteem. And at the same time, he has class," Mourinho said before Real's game against Racing Santander on Sunday in La Liga.
"The way he handled the Ballon d'Or for Harryâ¦ all I saw and felt was class. And respect.
"It's one thing to know you're the best, and another to have respect for someone who has also worked hard to win a trophy. All I see in him is class."

## बैलन डी ओर 2024 के परिणाम

हाल ही में जारी किए गए मतदान के आंकड़ों के अनुसार, इंग्लैंड के कप्तान और बायर्न म्यूनिख के स्ट्राइकर हैरी केन ने फ्रांस के फारवर्ड काइलियान एमबापे को बेहद कम अंतर से पीछे छोड़ते हुए पुरुष बैलन डी ओर पुरस्कार अपने नाम किया है। यह इतिहास के सबसे कम अंतर वाले मुकाबलों में से एक रहा।

आयोजकों द्वारा शनिवार को साझा किए गए आंकड़ों के मुताबिक:
* **हैरी केन:** 1,055 अंक (प्रथम स्थान)
* **काइलियान एमबापे:** 1,027 अंक (द्वितीय स्थान)
* **लामिन यामल:** 881 अंक (तृतीय स्थान)

## ऐतिहासिक जीत और आंकड़े

यह जीत कई मायनों में ऐतिहासिक रही:
* हैरी केन माइकल ओवेन (2001) के बाद बैलन डी ओर जीतने वाले पहले अंग्रेजी खिलाड़ी बन गए हैं।
* वह कुल मिलाकर पांचवें ऐसे अंग्रेजी खिलाड़ी हैं जिन्हें यह सम्मान मिला है।
* केन और एमबापे के बीच का 28 अंकों का अंतर साल 2019 के बाद से सबसे कम जीत का अंतर है, जब लियोनेल मेस्सी ने वर्जिल वान डिक को सात अंकों से हराया था।

रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, केन ने पिछले सत्र में 65 मैचों में 73 गोल किए थे, जिससे उनकी टीम को घरेलू प्रतियोगिताओं में सफलता मिली और इंग्लैंड की टीम ने विश्व कप में तीसरा स्थान प्राप्त किया।

## मतदान प्रक्रिया और प्रतिक्रियाएं

यह पुरस्कार 100 पत्रकारों के वोटों और एक भारित अंक प्रणाली के आधार पर तय किया जाता है। एमबापे के दूसरे स्थान पर रहने के बाद, रियल मैड्रिड के मुख्य कोच जोस मोरिन्हो ने एमबापे के व्यवहार की प्रशंसा की और कहा कि उन्होंने इस परिणाम को बहुत परिपक्वता और सम्मान के साथ स्वीकार किया है।

इस पुरस्कार की पुष्टि और अधिकृत मतदान विवरण के लिए, प्रशंसक फुटबॉल संघों और आधिकारिक पुरस्कार आयोजकों की घोषणाओं की जांच कर सकते हैं।

en_body:
## Historic Voting Breakdown

Recently released voting figures reveal that England captain Harry Kane clinched the men's Ballon d'Or by a margin of just 28 points, making it one of the closest finishes in the history of the award. According to organisers, the Bayern Munich striker accumulated 1,055 points, narrowly defeating Real Madrid forward Kylian Mbappe, who finished second with 1,027 points. Spain forward Lamine Yamal took third place with 881 points.

The 28-point gap represents one of the slimmest winning margins recorded, following Lionel Messi's seven-point victory over Virgil van Dijk in 2019. Historically, the award has even closer precedents, having been decided by a single point in 1966 when Bobby Charlton edged out Eusebio, and again in 1996 when Matthias Sammer defeated Ronaldo.

## A Milestone for English Football

Kane's victory marks several notable milestones:

* First Englishman to win the prestigious award since Michael Owen in 2001.
* Fifth English player overall to claim the prize, joining Stanley Matthews, Bobby Charlton, Kevin Keegan, and Michael Owen.
* Culmination of a prolific season featuring 73 goals in 65 matches.

Organised via a weighted points system decided by 100 international journalists, the award ceremony took place in London on Monday, where legendary Brazilian striker Ronaldo presented the trophy to Kane.

## Reactions and Practical Implications

Real Madrid head coach Jose Mourinho commented publicly on Mbappe's reaction to finishing second, praising the French forward's maturity and respect following the announcement.

Football supporters and analysts looking to verify the official voting breakdown and further details can consult the original announcements published by football governing bodies and the Ballon d'Or organisation.
